source_text: For simplicity, when stating and describing the results of this chapter, a number of assumptions are made regarding the regularity of the variables used to characterise the flow (density, velocity, etc.). Note, however, that it is possible to weaken those assumptions in some cases.
translated_text: 为简单起见, 在叙述和说明本章结果时, 我们对用于刻画流动的变量(密度, 速度等)的正则性作出若干假设. 不过应注意, 在某些情形下可以放宽这些假设.

source_text: We begin by describing a fundamental result of differentiation, known in fluid mechanics as the transport theorem. It shows us how to differentiate the value of a scalar quantity integrated over a fluid element (Omega_t)_t.
translated_text: 我们首先叙述一个基本的微分结果, 在流体力学中称为输运定理. 它说明如何对流体元上积分的标量值求导.

source_text: We assume that, for each t, the map phi_t is a smooth diffeomorphism and that t maps to phi_t is smooth. To simplify the notation a little we also set phi(t,x)=phi_t(x)=X(t,0,x).
translated_text: 我们假设, 对每个 t, 映射 phi_t 是光滑微分同胚, 并且 t 到 phi_t 的映射是光滑的. 为略微简化记号, 还采用原文给出的等同记号.

source_text: Theorem I.2.1. For any function f of class C^1 with respect to the variables (t,X) in R x R^3, the transport identity holds for any time t, where v is the vector field in R^3 defined in (I.2).
translated_text: 设函数 f 关于变量 (t,X) 属于 C^1 类. 则对任意时刻 t, 原文给出的输运恒等式成立, 其中 v 是由前述运动学关系定义的向量场.

source_text: At a fixed t, change variables from x in Omega_0 to X=phi(t,x) in Omega_t. J is the Jacobian determinant. Trilinearity of the determinant and (I.3) give the displayed derivative identities and determinant expansion.
translated_text: 固定 t, 作原文给出的变量替换. J 是相应映射的 Jacobian 行列式. 利用行列式的三线性与前述等价关系, 得到原文所列导数恒等式和行列式展开.

source_text: Apply the chain rule, introduce row vectors L_k and M_k, and use the trilinear alternating determinant to derive the Jacobian differential equation and the derivative of its absolute value.
translated_text: 应用链式法则, 引入行向量 L_k 和 M_k, 再利用行列式的三线性与交错性, 推导 Jacobian 行列式的微分方程以及其绝对值的导数.

source_text: Differentiate under the integral sign, apply the product and chain rules, then use the inverse change of variables to obtain the transport identity.
translated_text: 应用积分号下求导理论与乘积法则、链式法则, 再作反向变量替换, 得到输运恒等式.

source_text: Remark I.2.1. The scalar differentiation result generalises to vector equations. In condensed form F(t,X) is a vector quantity and the displayed identity uses div(F tensor v). The vector field v is the same as in the preceding theorem; Appendix A defines div(F tensor v).
translated_text: 这个标量方程的微分结果可以推广到向量方程. 原文以简洁形式给出相应向量恒等式. 其中的向量场 v 与前述定理中的相同, 而相应散度的定义见附录中的向量算子说明.
